hero.source: Wickenbug Vulture Mine -Entrance to Vulture Miine
hero.description: After Henry Wickenburg discovered the Vulture Mine, Vulture City a small mining town was established in the area. In 1870, the town once had a population of 5,000 citizens After the mine closed the city was deserted and became a “ghost town”. The mine and the ghost town are now a tourist attraction in Wickenberg, Arizona. The image is of the entrance to the Vulture Mine.
